_about: Labeled benchmark set for corroborate-mcp (release law: no release without published error rates).
_provenance: True claims drawn 2026-07-10 from Google News top/section feeds + Hacker News front page, REPHRASED (never verbatim headlines) so keyword extraction and the relevance gate are genuinely exercised. Fabricated claims are invented. Stale claims are real pre-2026 events. Distorted claims take a real current event and invert or falsify one key fact.
_refresh_policy: true_widely_reported / true_niche / distorted claims age out — refresh from current news roughly every 60 days (search window caps at 90d). fabricated and stale claims are evergreen.
